reviews.comment: he does a good job at outlining what he's looking for on tests. He's an easy grader and cares more about process than anything else. iclicker for attendance but I'd recommend showing up just so you don't get lost. Sometimes it's confusing and I have to go back and reteach myself. From what I've heard he's better than other prof for this course

Bret Lockhart is amazing, I enjoyed having him and he is the reason why I did so well in calc 2. His notes cover a lot of "twists" each unit can have, making you very prepared for the common exams. He wants the best for his students and does want you to succeed. STUDY. In his words, "You can never be too prepared for the exam" Favorite Prof at TAMU

What I like about this prof was that he guided students on how to manage their time and course early on and how to be smart with calc 2. I was happy with my grade and thankful for his timely guidance and mental help before exams.

He was very clear about most of what would be on the test. He gave a ton of resources, encouraged group participation oftentimes, and gave straightforward explanations of the material. I really enjoyed his class. Cool guy

He came off as fairly bored teaching MATH 152. The most engaging lecture of the year was when Shrader covered for him. Lectures are BORING and I didn't find that I learned from them. I get that this is a weed out class but you can still care about student's success. I ended with an 89 BEFORE the curve and still got a B. Take a different professor.

Lockhart encouraged students to ask questions. He explained things clearly and broke down exams before we would take them. This is a difficult class, but if you put in the effort this class is 100% doable. Quiz every week, but a lot were group and open notes.

Professor Lockhart explains concepts very well, but his class is not an easy A. Attendance is not mandatory, but I highly recommend it. I also recommend doing practice problems in the textbook, especially the more difficult ones, because they will help you prepare for the exams/quizzes. Again, not an easy A, but attainable if you put in the work.

lockhart breaks problems down very well but after maybe two examples he tends to become more fast paced so its easy to stop following. however he is a very understanding prof and will stop for questions along the way. he's also generally just an easy person to talk to and easy to go to with any concerns and cares a lot about his students.

He was awesome!! Some days attendance is mandatory. His class is known for being hard but I thought he did great explaining everything. He moves fast but they way his class is organized makes it a lot easier. If you're not a quick math learner I would not recommend it as much. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

His lectures consist of working through problems that not only break down the concept but develop the exact logic you will apply to solve problems on quizzes and exams. For the most part, there are no curveballs and his quizzes help you prepare for the exams well. He's also very nice and very no-nonsense, plus very approachable. Dr Lockhart my goat
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Would 100% recommend Lockhart! He is able to break down the hard concepts from 142 in a way that is understandable. The only bad thing is that he is often restricted/held to certain standards that the math department requires, but he tries his best to help out the students as much as he can. Will keep things real and is very accessible!

Definitely attend lectures and take good notes. If you participate and pay attention to his lectures you'll be just fine. People make calc 2 way more dramatic than it needs to be, and Lockhart does the job just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lockhart is only decent if you are already familiar with the concepts he "teaches." His lectures seemed more like rapid reviews as all he does is work on problems without giving thorough explanations. If you struggle with math then be prepared to self teach and heavily rely on the MLC.

He's a great professor and seems to really care about his students! I would definitely recommend going to office hours if you're confused. Honestly this class is super hard no matter what professor you have. The math department is just like that. I believe in you!
He's a really nice guy and genuinely likes what he does. Tests are pretty hard.

I liked Lockhart, but his lectures are really boring. At the end of the semester, he dropped two things from each category which was really nice, and tried to curve the grades at the end. I thought the class was easy, but I did take adv math in HS. Do all the homeworks and week reviews. He really does try and explain things in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lockhart is genuinely a sweet guy. I think he gets a lot of bad reviews just because he's direct, but he's amazing at teaching. Would've gotten an A if it wasn't for silly mistakes on exams, but they're pretty easy. Honestly just do the work, don't procrastinate studying at all, and go to his office hours, they're very helpful.

He was a fine teacher. He was quite gracious about extra credit and drops at the end of the semester. However, he was boring at times despite a good knowledge of the subject. He seemed to care about his students a good deal and fought to bump up to the next letter grade if at all possible.

Don't take Lockhart for math 140. He is very degrading and doesn't allow students to ask questions. He teaches towards kids who already have a strong math background, and makes it known that if you don't you will struggle. He makes his exams extremely hard and nothing like any practice exams or anything he tells you to study.

Professor Lockhart often makes students feel bad about themselves. He does not like it when you ask questions. I am not sure if it was because this was his first time teaching a class that was not high-level, but his patience was very short and he was very neglectful in actually teaching and explaining rather than just saying a bunch of words

Lockhart is a good teacher! He goes over what to focus on studying for each exam. Exams are pretty straight forward and most of the quizzes are open note, group quizzes. He does teach pretty fast, so having a good foundation in math is beneficial. There are occasional mandatory attendance days, but I recommend just showing up as lecture is helpful.

I had him for math 135(math for teachers) and he was great. He clearly cared a lot about the class, and the tests were not too hard if you just study the homework's and quizzes. Lots of group, open-note quizzes and overall, he was a kind professor.

I dropped the class because the teacher was extremely difficult and unapproachable. He didn't allow students to introduce themselves and expected us to already know material he never taught. The exams were far harder than the practice problems, making it nearly impossible to succeed even with serious studying.

He's not terrible but I do think you have to be pretty proficient at math already before going into his class. My main issue was the tests (which I should have studied more for anyways). But they are kinda hard to study for bc there's no review. He basically recommends everything which isn't really helpful in narrowing down.

I took math 142 last spring and the tests were extremely hard, but he always made it clear which type of questions would be on the test. He explains complex math in a very understandable way. He was also always nice when answering my homework questions before class. I recommend getting a whiteboard and doing the practice problems in the textbook!

His exams are extremely difficult and nothing like the homework or practice exams given. I feel as though he makes students feel bad for asking questions. He degrades our ability to do math a lot. He doesn't teach like all the other math 140 professors, so going to the math 140 tutoring just makes everything even more confusing.

Worst prof possible for 142. A student asked him to explain how a concept is used in real life. He said, "I could explain that but you guys are my business kids, not engineering, y'all won't be building bridges, you don't need to know that." He is not personable and won't even shake hands. He also has the hardest exams and provides no study review.

Has some of the hardest tests in the math department, quizzes are hard. He is very cold and if you ask a question thats not to his liking he is gonna be rude answering it. He goes through hia lectures very fast and kinda just expects you to know the material already.
DO NOT TAKE! The only thing he tells you is that you are going to fail! If you do take him, I'd start praying right now!
He is unable to answer questions if not worded specifically in his way of thinking. Office hours were a joke and his exams are a lot more difficult compared to other professors.

I took AP Cal BC in hs, but his methods of teaching is a bit complicated and confusing. I knew my algebra/pre calc basics, but when he taught them, they were different technique, sometimes even more confusing than what I was taught in hs. Doesn't answer a lot of questions in lecture. Lots of hw but the hw/quizzes don't help as much on the test.

Taken Spring 2025. Calculus at A&M is very difficult. I hated this class, but Professor Lockhart was not that reason. Professors under this course are forced to follow a strict curriculum and tests must reach a required level of difficulty. Professor Lockhart is a great person, and he taught very well. He even made his exams on the easier side.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lockhart is great, he really only follows the University given notes and home-works. He does not stray outside of that, and there is an expectation that you have reinforced math from high school. If you are struggling, he does not really like to answer questions so I would recommend Hands On Grades Up or the TA's
He's ok, but he definitely makes the exams harder each time and it's confirmed by a bunch of the math 140 tutors too.

Lockhart is a great prof. He teaches fast but is a very good teacher and wants to help students. Any complaints that I have about this class are not Professor Lockhart's fault, it's simply because I don't like math. The class is hard but that's just the nature of calculus, you'll be fine but be prepared for a lot of work.
He is a really good professor and explains everything very well, but class pace is difficult (Summer).
dont take him over the summer. he makes things way too complicated

Professor Lockhart genuinely cares about his students' success. If you're willing to spend time outside the lectures to learn the content and practice, you'll be fine. Calculus is difficult to learn in one semester, so students without prior knowledge may struggle.

Great guy great professor, any beef with him is really with the TAMU Math department. I'm genuinely awful at math hence the D (still got the credit lol). He cares about his students and despite personal matters in his own life he made every attempt to be there for us. Exams are hard but he tries to give slack especially after spring break.Great guy

Idk how to feel ab this prof, I had his wife &loved her, ik that their family is going through a lot so I don't want to be too harsh, I think he made the class more difficult than it had to be, like "ppl above him" would be mad if his class did too good on exams, and hw/lectures would only "help with concepts," pretty easy if youre good at algebra2

He's super cool and caring. I like math and I took calculus in highschool so none of the material was new for me. Weekly homework, semi-weekly in class quizzes (doesn't give a lot of time for them), three exams, and a final (replaces lowest exam). Will do drops depending on what his department allows. He's fun to talk to and will answer questions.

Lockhart is a great professor, explains concepts well, and is helpful when he can be. Math department doesn't allow much flexibility so this makes him seem harsher than he is. His exams are hard, but that is expected. Getting a C in the class because of dumb mistakes on exams and am I'm not great at math. Put the work in and you'll be fine.
Very good Professor who is easy to understand and is reasonable with his work. I would recommend him!

Very fast paced and hard material but super straightforward guy. He will be honest about where he expects you to be at and when. 2 Webassigns a week and a couple video quizzes but totally manageable. Exams are hard but nothing that is not covered in homework, quizzes, and lectures. Quizzes are open note and he will help you if you ask. Great prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Any problems people have with Prof. Lockhart, they really have with the math department. Nazi Germany gave more freedom to its people than what the TAMU math department gives to its professors. Lockhart is a chiller. I had never taken a lick of calculus, and I've been able to keep up. Just actually do the homework, you will learn a lot that way.
Not a good professor, doesn't really teach things and excepts you to already know them.

Although he is a professor, he does not like when questions are asked during lectures, and would often make students feel discouraged for not understanding the material. The exams were always extremely difficult, and he was not good at helping students prepare for them. TA's were also no help either.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is easy, materials are easy...if you already knew it. If you don't, don't expect to really understand what is going on and be prepared to study a bit. If you knew the stuff coming in, you don't need to study at all. The prof does a POOR job of teaching and does not help students understand, but rather just to do problems, which doesn't help.

This professor makes the concepts clear and straightforward to understand, so pay attention during the lectures and do lots of practice problems. He is genuinely a good professor, but just make sure to put effort in too! It's just a matter of knowing what you have to do and staying on top of everything.

Lockhart is a super nice guy, definitely cares about student success, but he goes over a lot of topics assuming you already know it. Overall, not a bad class, especially if you took AP Calc in high school. Class content really isn't hard at all, but I found the exams to be harder than what was gone over in lecture.

Lockhart is great. He teaches everything really well and stops to make sure everyone understands. deadlines are strict but he will drop the lowest two grades in each category. textbook is super easy to follow and hw isn't too long. Tests really aren't too hard. if you took Calc AB in HS you are gonna be fine class is sooo easy knowing clac.

Lockhart is clear and informative and I can tell he genuinely cares about his students. He deserves a better ranking on this page. He makes everything easy to understand and I enjoyed his personality as well. Stay on top of your work + come to class and you will be successful! Be smart when studying and you can guess what will be on the exams.
He is just hard to work with.

Very passionate professor who loves teaching, and knows a good amount of higher level math! This class was difficult for me tho since I didn't take precal or cal in HS, so it put me very behind. His teaching style is very fast and if you don't know calc before, it is very hard to catch up. Exam 3 was a killer w/failing average. Final sucked most.

Many people disliked Prof Lockhart, but I like & respect him. He's honest & straightforward, which can seem blunt/rude, but I appreciated it. After teaching in high school & college for so long he understands our thought processes & fully explains the 'why' behind concepts. He also provides new/different approaches. Just listen, try & put in effort

Prof. Lockhart was great. I'm not a math person, but he taught well and makes it possible to do well especially if you took pre-cal in high school. Lots of outside sources he provides for help. I overslept the entire class once and he let me follow him to his office hours and take the in-class quiz there.

If you have a decent background in math, TAKE LOCKHART! He does go fast, but he is a great professor. His tests are not any harder than what the homework and quizzes prepare you for. He sends out lots of resources and makes an effort to be accessible. Don't let people scare you out of his class; if you do your work, you will succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was scared to take Math 140 because I am not a math person. But this class was not hard if you pay attention. You should do the homework but it's not that hard. His quizzes are all open notes, peers, and TAs so it is easy to make a good grade. Professor Lockhart is a great guy and teaches very well I would tell anyone to take him.

I don't know why Bret gets hate; he comes in clutch when you need him. He explained things very clearly and taught in methods that would help you remember things for the exam, plus I loved his nerdy anecdotes and jokes. He doesn't tell you this in the beginning but he drops two iclickers, quizzes, video quizzes.

Tbh I actually really like prof Lockhart. Math 140 itself was not super difficult for me, but he explains everything and I thought he was a good prof. Tests are harder than they should be, but if you have basic knowledge of concepts you'll do decent. Lots of out of class homework though, but thats the class itself not prof.
He's a really good teacher, some of yall just don't do whats expected and complain. He explains everything very clearly and is super helpful if you ask questions.

Math 140 is basically an algebra/pre-calculus review, so if you were good with those in high school, you will do fine. Professor Lockhart goes through the material quickly, but throughout his lectures he will ask for questions. Attendance is not mandatory, however there are iClicker questions and quizzes during class.

Professor Lockhart is pretty good at explaining concepts, and this course isn't too difficult if you have a good knowledge of Algebra 2 and PreCalculus. Group quizzes are helpful, WebAssigns are annoying but not difficult with multiple attempts. My only issue was that he made tests harder than they needed to be.

Prof Lockhart acts like he's too good for his students. He treats first-semester freshmen like juniors or seniors who know all there is to know about the class and barely explains content, only practice problems. Not only that, but he does them extremely fast so if you're taking notes in a notebook, you may as well give up.

Pretty easy class if you have some basic knowledge of algebra and pre calculus. Studied the test review the night prior to each exam and ended up getting an A. Attendance is semi-mandatory. He will do quizzes and i-clicker occasionally (typically once a week) so as long as you don't miss that you're chilling. Lectures get a bit boring but whatevs.

Professor Lockhart is great at teaching calculus. While the exams can be challenging, his lectures, quizzes, and care for student success make the class manageable. Unstuck study AI was a helpful study tool alongside the class resources.

If you pay attention to the lecture and study the minimum amount, it is easy to get a B. The professor gives a lot of information about the content of the exams at least a week before you take them. Professor Lockhart doesn't curve but makes hard concepts very easy to understand.
He is definitely not fair. Exam times are super short max 30 min except the finals.

Overall this class was decent and organized. Lots of webassigns but they didn't take too long. Lectures are recorded so attendance isn't required. Tests were difficult sometimes and he would blame students for the low test averages instead of reflecting on the tests themselves.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Calculus is a difficult course but Lockhart explains each concept well. Time was an issue on exams at times. If you study hard you should be ok! Study the notes and the quizzes gives you. He really wants you to succeed and anybody who wrote a horrible review is just bad at math and it has nothing to do with his teaching abilities.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Some of his exams are a little rough, but you can make up those points through his collaborative and open-note iClickers and quizzes.  He really loves his job and is passionate about teaching calculus, and he's just a really nice person in general.  I highly recommend taking his class :)

I am terrible at math. I'm not a math lover by any means, but Professor Lockhart is great at teaching. I think he should be in charge of the math department because he understands the students. He wants to know his students and is funny too. He does group quizzes and can be pretty funny too.

Professor Lockhart was a good professor, he cared about his students and wanted to see them succeed. That said, he goes through the notes and lecture material fast at times, his exams can be difficult, and he will not curve. However, I am not very good at math and had no prior knowledge of calculus, and was still able to do alright in the class.

Professor Lockhart was the best calculus teacher. He really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He does weekly quizzes but they really help to prepare you for the exam, and he doesn't try to trick you. He usually drops a few grades at the end. I am not a math person but his lecture's were good and helpful! Take him for 142!

Only take this professor if you feel that you are pretty decent at Math/algebra, his exams are not very forgiving. Not very leniant on late assignments, and is very strict on the honor code. Made the 3rd exam 10x harder than the previous exams because our section "did too well on them". Led to a failing grade average for the exam.

I took Professor Lockhart for Math 140 and 142 and absolutely LOVED him. I would say that the material is hard if you are not a math person, but Lockhart is good at explaining topics in lectures and gives you everything you need to be successful on each test. He also posts lectures on Zoom so going to class is optional unless there is a quiz.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He expects you to already know calc before the class even starts. He does not explain anything and makes his own exams. He also teaches way too fast and makes you feel stupid if you ask any questions. He thinks his exams are easy but class averages are no better than a 55. I would not recommend
Terrible professor. Would not recommend to anybody.

do not take!! goes over material very quickly, and homework is nothing like lectures. claimed he made his tests "easy" when the class average was in the 50s. all exams had failing averages. also does not curve at all. he made this class much more difficult than it needed to be, and offered little to no help,went to office hours and that did nothing
Not a good professor. Averages on the tests are in the 50-60 range, and he does not curve at all.

Teaches at a substandard. For a math 140 class, he made tests much harder than they needed to be. There are so many other professors you can take and research into so for your sanity do not take this professor.

Professor Lockhart makes this class way harder than it has to be.  He makes the tests insanely hard, teaches really fast, and does not explain things very well. If you have the option to take this class with a different professor, then do it.

He does NOT curve the class. He leads you to believe there will be a curve in the end. Exam 3 is the worst! Then you have to take the final and you will fail. You will spend all your money on tutor john and still fail his test because he doesn't use numbers, he uses letters. DO NOT RECOMMEND TO ANYONE!!! class average was failing.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lockhart will not curve, but he is the best mathematics lecturer I've had from 151, 152, 253, and 308. He makes concepts easy to understand and he recorded and posted lectures so we could watch them as many times as we needed.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Where do I even start....  Do not take him I promise you it is for the greater good. YOU WILL MOST LIKELY FAIL THE FIRST EXAM IF YOU HAVE NEVER TAKEN CALC. He is a really tough grader, and isn't approachable or much help when it comes to studying for tests or doing homework.
Lockhart made the class easier than other professors and communicated when things would be graded by. He posts the lectures online and the weekly quizzes are easy.

FRESHMEN STAY AWAY! Horrible professor, too much homework, 4 difficult Tests with no wiggle room for mess up. He was bullied by the math department all semester; and never took up for the students; the last 2 tests were difficult on purpose to tank the class average! Horrible Grading system, you never know what your actual grade is till the end.

Professor Lockhart made the units incredibly more difficult than they needed to be and if you can avoid having him as a Math 140 professor, do so at all costs. He expects you to know upper level calculus and does not want to help at all. He is too smart to be teaching an entry level math course. He does not care about your grade at all.

I am horrendous at math, it's not his fault I made a C. He's about as good of a math professor as you can get. His lectures are recorded if you don't feel like going, but he has quizzes every Friday that you can work in groups to complete so i'd recommend going. Don't procrastinate on the homework, it takes longer than you think it would.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lockhart really knows and understands the material that he teaches. He doesn't rely on the textbook, but communicates the material in a way that makes it easy to understand. He also posts every lecture. i-Clicker once a week, typically on Friday so you can plan around it. Study and understand his quizzes and you will do well on the test.

Professor Lockhart is hands down one of the best professors for Calc 2. His lectures are very easy to follow and he cares a lot about his students (he was even willing to write me a LOR). The final was pretty easy, especially for a notoriously difficult class.

Pretty mid. I stopped going to class halfway through the semester because it wasn't helpful to me. I don't recommend this unless you're good at math. Exams were difficult but fair. My biggest complaint is that Professor Lockhart was not approachable; I am sure he cares for his students, but the few times I interacted with him, it was not evident.

The tests were hard, especially the free response questions. They were a little more difficult than the notes and homework, but if you go to class and get the basic concepts, you can apply them well. Find a group to do homework and quizzes with. He wasn't the most approachable but did his best to help. Utilize the math learning center resources!

He's aware that he purposely make the tests tough. According to the "math dept" our class avg cannot be "too high". He complained that we did too well, or above the other profs sections on exam 2 so he made exam 3 extremely hard. His lectures are important and it's crucial to get on top of this class because there is so much content.

Class: Tough, time consuming. Multiple HW's + a quiz due every week. All exams are really hard, math dept has it out for freshmen and tests way harder than what is on HWs + quizzes so beware. 
Professor: OK. Very organized and offers lots of resources. His attitude is off putting but he's just strict and concise on what he wants/needs.

Great professor, challenging class. Quizzes could be done in groups & were due midnight. He records all of the lessons and posts the completed notes. He wants you to do well in his class and it shows by the number of resources he provides. Tests are hard but go to the math center and study ahead of time and you will get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He has to teach based on the guidance of the math dept., who is satisfied with C/D average test scores and aims for them to not be high. No extra credit, just do well on the first exams and study hard. We got a curveball of a 3rd exam, rly unfair, and simply to satisfy the math dept. who must approve everything taught. Most prof will be the same...

If you go to class you'll be fine.  He gives weekly group quizzes that are super easy, while other Math 140 professors give individual quizzes that are more difficult.  He is so good at explaining things and is easy to follow.  I think he's the best math 140 professor by far!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had already seen pretty much all the content we had in highschool already, but Professor Lockhart had some new techniques that he showed us that were really helpful. He's a good lecturer, easy-going guy, and despite me having this class at 8am 3 times a week I never minded going. Great teacher!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lockhart is a caring professor he might come off a little strange to some but he is one of the best math teachers I have had. Go to every class and do not miss any because you will fully understand what he is teaching if you are there. Has quizzes on Fridays but are take home and relatively easy just work with friends.

Lockhart was a really great professor who truly cared about his students and the grades they received. He would try his utmost hardest to make sure that everyone understood the material. He is very energetic and loves talking about his kids. I 100% would take him again and am taking him again for another math class. He is not for everyone though.

Excellent professor, explains math in a way I've never had a teacher do before. Definitely a big nerd, you can tell he loves what he teaches. Be prepared for homework with webassign, video notes, and weekly group quizzes every week. The class is very manageable if you stay on top of things and go to class. Can be a bit blunt sometimes.

reviews.comment: Lockhart is very strict, no excuses in his class and this can translate as he doesn't care about your learning/student experience. Utitlize his class groupme, zoom recordings and practice exams. Attendance not mandatory. Studying is very necessary as his exams are rough, usually a step above HW's and quizzes.

Lockhart is a wonderful teacher! You can tell that he enjoys what he does. Make sure you have a good grasp of how Canvas works before his class - most if not all of your work will be found there. Make sure you go to class and take as many notes as you can, and make sure you stay on top of homework.
Just no

Effective teacher with decent lectures and an abundance of material provided prior to sections. can be a little callous at times but all things considered he's pretty approachable. Do not underestimate tests, and if he says something is a good idea, do it ASAP. Great person to talk to and gives decent feedback and good for pointers when stuck.

reviews.comment: Lockhart is great at teaching. Always attend lectures and take notes. His quizzes are always difficult but it makes the exams feel easy, and he drops some at the end of the term. He is very strict but in the best way possible.

I had Professor Lockhart for MATH 151 and 152, and he's the best math teacher I've ever had! He does many example problems in lecture, and if you take good notes and study them, the exams are pretty easy. I highly recommend him!

VERY good at teaching. Attend 100% of his lectures, take notes ACTIVELY, review your notes at the end of each week (be consistent about this), finish all homework a few days early & do all practice common exams before each exam. An A will be an absolute no-brainer. Finals are very hard so study thoroughly for it.
His class was very hard but he's a very good lecturer. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lockhart was a great professor, his notes are good enough to prepare you for the exams and his quizzes aren't terribly hard. The department decided to make the math courses harder, so the difficulty can't be attributed towards the professor. Go to class, pay attention, and if you understand the material well enough, you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lockhart is stubborn and likes things done his way, but is an incredible professor and will prepare you very well. Only math prof I know who posts recorded lectures, which is really nice bc if I was sick / over slept / he went too fast in class, I could go back and watch the recording and take notes at my own pace. His quizzes are notoriously hard.
Great prof, just remember that everything that he does will set you up for success which includes his pretty difficult quizzes so make sure to study those every week and attend lecture.

Great professor I took him for 151/152. His quizzes were kinda hard but he drops some at the end of the semester. His lectures are easy to follow and he is easy to understand. Definitely would be my #1 choice for calc if I had to take it again, I just wish he taught calc 3 so i could still have him.

Honestly, he's one of the better math professors I've had. I was behind from a bad experience the semester prior with a different professor, and had to retake math 152.
